notes:
v4.6.105 — Cleaner bot deletes, a Clear-cache button, and a fixed web dashboard

🗑️ DELETE = GONE EVERYWHERE
• Deleting a custom bot now also removes it from the cloud: it's stopped on every broker, dropped from the 24/7 keep-alive registry, and its server script is deleted. No more deleted bots lingering or reappearing.

🧹 CLEAR LOCAL CACHE
• Account → Storage → 'Clear local cache' frees disk by removing this account's cached equity-history / charts / logs. Your bots, keys and settings are kept — the cloud holds the real records and the app re-downloads what it needs.

🌐 WEB DASHBOARD (already live on the server)
• The browser dashboard now lists your real bots from your synced registry (deleted bots no longer show), and silenced bots are shown muted/dashed with a SILENCED badge, distinct from active bots.

Update via the in-app banner.
